transport: https loopback via counting TLS proxy (private test CA, strict verification); TLS handled by the agent's rustls; byte counts are plaintext HTTP bytes after TLS termination (no TLS record/handshake overhead); traffic on loopback only, no real network latency

measurement_method.cpu: agent user+system CPU from the OS per-process accounting (macOS proc_pid_rusage, Linux /proc/stat), delta over wall clock; waited collector children added separately (child CPU of terminated, waited-for children)
measurement_method.memory: resident set (RSS) of the agent process once per second; macOS also physical footprint; child RSS only sampled at 1 s so short-lived collector children can be missed
measurement_method.overhead: sampler CPU = this script's own process CPU, reported separately; proxy and server run in other processes and are not charged to the sampler or agent

outage_test.note: Spool bound (120 reports / 4 MiB / 1 h) is exercised by unit tests, not by this outage length. An outage of 300 s queues about 10 reports.

collector_costs.note: From `hope-agent benchmark` in a separate process; the first sample includes one-time initialisation. Inventory (hostname/OS/disks/network) is rebuilt on every sample and sent when it changes or hourly; gpu_inventory refreshes hourly.
